## Review and approvals
- [ ] Material Claude Code Review findings resolved, or openly escalated
- [ ] At least one **independent human** has reviewed the latest diff
- [ ] Sensitive ontology, code, or governance changes receive **two** independent human reviews

- [ ] Required checks green; any changes after approval re-reviewed

**Do not self-approve, mark a bot review as human approval, or auto-merge.**
